name: Ray Marching with Secant Refinement
definition: A procedure to detect surface points along rays by evaluating a neural decoder at proposal points, identifying sign changes in occupancy logits, and refining the depth using a root-finding method.
summary: Ray Marching with Secant Refinement detects surface intersections by identifying sign changes in neural occupancy logits and refining depth estimates using linear interpolation between bracketing points for higher precision than simple bisection.
